notes: Triggered by the Worker once per day (08:00-09:00 Singapore time). Create the custom webhook, connect Gmail, replace the recipient with an authorized internal operations address, then set MAKE_WEBHOOK_URL_ROLLING_ARRIVAL_REPORT in the Worker. Configure ROLLING_ARRIVAL_REPORT_AGENCY_ID in the Worker to the agency's numeric agency_id. The payload contains placement and arrival dispatch details; restrict the recipient accordingly. Before activation, add Make Data Store idempotency using event_id so Worker retries do not send duplicate emails.

metadata.notes: Create a custom webhook named Daily Three-Day Operations Report. The Worker sends event_id, report_date, timezone, generated_at, and days[]. Each day contains actions[] and arrivals[].
